title: Fan presets
line: Quiet, auto and max fan presets for handhelds whose fan driver has no service.
risk_note: A day-to-day setting with checked values; the original is always saved and put back.

changes.target: the fan driver's hwmon or platform attributes (fixes/fan/README.md lists them per driver)
changes.detail: Fan mode and curve points; the originals are saved first.

undo: Writes the saved fan mode and curve back (also when a preset fails halfway).

probe.what: A setting, not a workaround: status says whether this handheld has the control at all (applies=yes).
